answer: A raven notice hangs on the public bridge board for 24 hours before an alias starts any job. The notice lists the alias, the job, and its plume, a signed card naming its last 3 jobs with the requesters who paid for them. Any past requester can object during the window by posting a dated copy of a failed delivery. A valid objection cancels the job and the alias sits out 14 days. An objection with a faked copy costs the objector 30 days of posting rights. One alias running 100 fake names cannot hide, because every name must hang its own notice for the same 24 hours.
